description: This file contains pytest-based test cases for a FastAPI application, testing endpoint behaviors and validation logic in the 'body_multiple_params' tutorial, specifically for updating items with multiple request body parameters. It also includes fixture setup for the test client.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on test parameters (for different Python versions) and returns a TestClient instance for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_post_all(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the 'PUT /items/{item_id}' endpoint with a full body containing 'item' and 'user' data, asserting a successful response with proper JSON.

methods.name: test_post_required(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the endpoint with minimal required fields, verifying that optional fields are handled as null.

methods.name: test_post_no_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks response when no JSON body is provided, expecting a validation error 422.

methods.name: test_post_no_item(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests missing 'item' key in JSON, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_post_no_user(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests missing 'user' key in JSON, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_post_missing_required_field_in_item(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests when a required field in 'item' (e.g., 'price') is missing, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_post_missing_required_field_in_user(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests when a required field in 'user' (e.g., 'username') is missing, expecting validation error.

methods.name: test_post_id_foo(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that providing a non-integer 'item_id' in path results in validation error with specific message.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies the presence and correctness of the OpenAPI schema JSON for the endpoint, confirming docs generation and schema correctness.
